lines.text: Ashgrave Manor, eighteen eighty-nine. Lady Verity lies dead, a black orchid in her hand. Before midnight, you must prove who killed her, how, and why.
The case runs in three short chapters. Your goals sit at the top, so you always know the next move.
Sweep your lantern across each room. Anything that glints is evidence. Click it, and it flies into your case file.
At the forensics lab, pick the test you think fits. A wrong guess simply fizzles. The right one reveals the poison.
One letter survived the fire. Piece the scraps back together, and a motive returns.
Every suspect is an AI character guarding a secret. Present the evidence that breaks a line of their story, and the lie cracks.
Stuck? Lady Verity's ghost will nudge you. And your evidence board ties every clue to the lie it broke.
When you're ready, make three choices: who, how, and why. One accusation. No second chances.
Every move lands in your team's Mattermost through Switch, so friends can play straight from chat.
Ashgrave. A murder mystery your team solves together.
